page.layout: Two printed pages. Left page: running head "INDEX" at top; two parallel columns of Greek index words with page and line references, separated by a vertical rule; below the second column, the letter headings Z and H with their entries. Right page: a partly cut-off index page with a running head "IND" and a narrow column of references at its right edge.
page.head: Z.
H.
page.notes: The right page is cut off at its outer edge, so its Greek entries are mostly lost and are not transcribed. The Greek index words are copied from a handwritten-looking print and several are uncertain; the first letters of several entries (ἐλαφχθησαν, ζυλαχθεὶς, ζυφεσνθῆναι, ἡγαλλιάσατο) are doubtful. The Z and H headings are set larger in the original and may be letter headings. No page number is printed.
